note: Genome = one float per gene, in this order. Phase 3: stats are fixed (founders get the defaults, plus optional founders.gene_jitter); Phase 4 adds mutation. Integer genes are rounded when used. Energy costs are not genes: base burn, sense burn and move cost are derived from these genes (spec 4.1.1, entity.burn_* / sense_cost_per_cell / move_cost_* params) when the genome is fixed. `cost` names the derived term each gene feeds (spec principle 4).

genes.name: food_needed_to_sate
genes.desc: Share of max_energy at which the entity is sated and stops eating; hunger is measured against it.
genes.cost: Higher means more time spent eating.

genes.name: digest_efficiency
genes.desc: Energy gained = item nutrition x this.

genes.name: move_speed
genes.desc: Cells per tick on cost-1 terrain.
genes.cost: Base burn: + entity.burn_k_speed x move_speed^2; move cost per cell: entity.move_cost_floor + entity.move_cost_k_speed x move_speed^2.

genes.name: sense_radius
genes.desc: Chebyshev radius (cells) of the perception scan.
genes.cost: Sense burn per tick: entity.sense_cost_per_cell x (2 x sense_radius + 1)^2 (every scanned cell).

genes.name: memory_capacity
genes.cost: Base burn: + entity.burn_k_memory x memory slots.

genes.name: forage
genes.desc: Weight of eating and of seeking remembered food.
genes.cost: Behavioural weight; no direct energy cost.

genes.name: rest
genes.desc: Weight of resting (lower burn, no movement) when not hungry.
genes.cost: Behavioural weight; no direct energy cost.

genes.name: explore
genes.desc: Weight of wandering, which rises with hunger when no food is in sight.

genes.name: carry_corpse
genes.desc: Weight of picking up and carrying a corpse when not hungry.
genes.cost: Carrying slows movement (entity.carry_speed_factor) and costs entity.carry_move_cost_factor x the move cost per cell.
